name: jQuery UI
project_description: Re-provides the jQuery UI 1.13.2 asset library that Drupal core deprecated (from Drupal 9) and made internal after removing it as a public API. jQuery UI was minimally maintained upstream and marked End of Life by the OpenJS Foundation, so core no longer offers it; this module ships the bundled JS/CSS themes/images so existing themes, modules and custom code that still depend on jQuery UI keep working. It declares the base libraries jquery_ui/core, jquery_ui/widget, jquery_ui/mouse, jquery_ui/position and jquery_ui/locale in jquery_ui.libraries.yml, and dynamically declares the full set of internal jQuery UI sub-libraries plus the widget/effect libraries for companion projects (jquery_ui_accordion, jquery_ui_datepicker, jquery_ui_dialog, jquery_ui_effects, etc.) via a hook_library_info_alter() implementation that reads jquery_ui.libraries.data.json. It has no configuration UI, no permissions, no routes (beyond hook_help) and no services. To migrate legacy code, replace old core/jquery.ui* library references with the jquery_ui/* equivalents. The maintainers recommend selecting a maintained replacement rather than adding new jQuery UI dependencies.
